text_block_list.text:
One day, as I passed near the back of the 
school building—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's just you, Trainer. ...Don't scare 
me like that.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No problem. I had a similar ache this 
morning, but it went away quickly. More 
importantly――

text_block_list.name: Entourage
text_block_list.text:
Ah, King~. Here you are! I was looking all 
over for you~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm sorry for vanishing so suddenly. I 
just got caught up in a little chat.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'll be heading over to the plaza in a 
moment, so could you two go on ahead?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Keep it a secret from those girls, okay? 
I'd hate for them to fuss over me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'll let you know when I'm genuinely not 
feeling well. So there's no need for you 
to worry unnecessarily.

King Halo seems to be troubled by a 
headache...
